summary: Bunge Global SA filed a routine Form 8-K reporting that its wholly owned finance subsidiaries, Bunge Limited Finance Corp. and Bunge Finance Europe B.V., together with creditors, extended three existing unsecured revolving credit facilities. The $1.1 billion 364-day facility maturity moves from October 2, 2026 to October 1, 2027; the $4.2 billion 5-year facility extends 12 months to October 3, 2031; the $3.5 billion 3-year facility extends 12 months to October 3, 2029. No special-situation event, no deal terms, no risk-arb angle; purely a liability-management disclosure.
